  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also the recommended first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.",

  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised.",

  "Large lesions also include acral lesions.",
  "Large lesions also include genital lesions.",
